title: Preview Renderer Metadata
description: Audit metadata identifying the implementation that produced a preview render. This metadata records implementation and safety behavior; it does not independently grant authority. Consumers determine authority from creative.preview fidelity and any applicable publisher preview_provider delegation.

version.description: Exact semantic version of the renderer implementation.

export.description: Renderer export or entry-point name used for this render.

fidelity.description: Fidelity asserted by the renderer endpoint. Publisher delegation may make representative output publisher-authoritative only within the delegated placement scope.

tracking_suppressed.description: True when the preview renderer suppresses impression, click, billing, conversion, and viewability side effects. Reference renderers SHOULD always emit true.
